_comment: Conformance checks to skip, as "<case id>::<check>": "<reason>", where the check is lenient, strict, tolerance, reencode or encode. A case believed wrong is listed here with evidence rather than edited.
mic-e/speed-190-to-199-knots::reencode: The case's canonical bytes contradict the README's own Mic-E rule: "the encoder uses the printable forms APRS12c ch. 10 allows (... course hundreds + 4)". The input's DC byte is ':' (speed units 3, course hundreds 0 without the + 4); with the + 4 it is '>', which this encoder writes (`/Xg/>O>...). Both read back as 193 knots and 51 degrees; only the + 4 form is the one the rule names.
mic-e/speed-190-to-199-knots-sent-as-del: The case's canonical bytes contradict the README's own Mic-E rule: "the encoder uses the printable forms APRS12c ch. 10 allows (... course hundreds + 4)". The input's DC byte is ':' (speed units 3, course hundreds 0 without the + 4); with the + 4 it is '>', which this encoder writes (`/Xg/>O>...).
